gpx.title: Route (GPX)
gpx.subtitle: Import a route file, review its source and summary, or export the current trip route.
gpx.importHint: GPX files are parsed on this device. Large or malformed files are rejected.
gpx.exportHint: Downloads a GPX 1.1 file for this track.
gpx.empty: No route imported for this trip.
gpx.invalid: This file is not a valid GPX route.
gpx.tooLarge: The file is too large (limit 5 MB).
gpx.noPoints: The GPX file contains no usable track points.
gpx.summary.title: Track summary
gpx.disclaimer: A GPX track is not an authoritative safe route. Imported data may be incomplete or outdated.
gpx.error.tooLarge: The file is too large (limit 5 MB).
gpx.error.malformed: The file could not be read as XML.
gpx.error.notGpx: The file root element is not <gpx>.
gpx.error.noPoints: The GPX file contains no usable track points.
gpx.error.readFailed: The file could not be read.
gpx.error.exportFailed: The GPX file could not be created.
gpx.notFound.title: Trip not found
gpx.notFound.body: It may have been deleted on this device.
gpx.warnings.title: Warnings
gpx.warning.multipleSegments: Multiple tracks or segments were merged. Distance between separate segments may be included as a straight line.
gpx.warning.elevationUnavailable: Elevation is missing for some or all points, so ascent is not calculated.
gpx.warning.invalidElevationIgnored: Some invalid elevation values were ignored.
gpx.map.heading: Route preview
gpx.map.title: Route preview: {name}
gpx.map.desc: Simplified preview of {count} track points on a plain background. It is not a map, does not show terrain, and is not an authoritative safe route.
gpx.removeBody: This removes the imported GPX track from this trip on this device. It cannot be undone.
